# UP-DCC Workspace

- This is a browser-only HTML, CSS, and JavaScript prototype. Open `index.html`; no build command or extension is required.
- Keep demo records fictional and label illustrative dates, school information, maps, and gallery graphics as unverified or placeholders.
- Never present the visible role switch as authentication or real authorization. Do not add real student data, passwords, or guardian information to this front end.
- File submissions, teacher posts, and grade edits are local demonstrations. Real accounts, persistence, uploads, messaging, and email require a secure, school-approved backend.
